__README__: ILLUSTRATIVE TEMPLATE — NOT CLINICALLY REVIEWED. This is the complete shape of an anchored ApoB file: every claim, every required field. The NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS to show format only — do NOT copy them into apob.json. Replace each value + audit field with your reviewed science, set review_status to ANCHORED, and the matching feature switches on. Leave a claim as DECLARED (or value null) to keep its feature off.

__required_fields__.claim_id: Fixed identifier — do NOT change; the engine binds to it.
__required_fields__.assertion: Plain-English description of what this claim asserts (shown in the audit/review surface).
__required_fields__.value: The science. number | string | object | null. null = feature stays off.
__required_fields__.unit: Unit of the value, or null (e.g. lexicon lists have no unit).
__required_fields__.version: Semver. Must NOT be 0.0.0 to anchor. Bump when the science changes.
__required_fields__.effective_date: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the value takes effect. Required to anchor.
__required_fields__.author: Named clinical owner who signed off. Required to anchor.
__required_fields__.provenance: Citation — guideline / paper / consensus the value comes from. Required to anchor.
__required_fields__.evidence_grade: Your grading, e.g. A | B | C | expert-consensus.
__required_fields__.review_status: ANCHORED to switch on. DECLARED = off. (VERSIONED also usable.)
